acs.text: POST /carts creates an empty cart and responds 201 with its id.
outcomes: POST /carts responds 201
the response body contains the cart's id
the new cart is empty (reading it via GET /carts/{id} lists no products)

acs.text: POST /carts/{id} with product_id and a quantity from 1 to 99 adds the product (200); adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity by the amount added.
outcomes: quantity 1 → 200 and the cart lists the product with quantity 1
quantity 99 → 200 and the cart lists the product with quantity 99
adding a product already in the cart increases its quantity by the amount added (the cart lists it once, with the summed quantity)

acs.text: A quantity outside 1–99 is rejected with 422 and an error for the quantity field; the cart is unchanged.
outcomes: quantity 0 → 422
quantity 100 → 422
the error response contains an error for the quantity field
the cart is unchanged after the rejected request (same products and quantities as before)

acs.text: On a product page, choosing a quantity and pressing "Add to cart" shows "Product added to shopping cart." and the cart icon in the navigation shows the total number of items.
outcomes: the message "Product added to shopping cart." is shown
the cart icon in the navigation shows the total number of items in the cart

acs.text: The cart page (checkout step 1) lists each product with its quantity, unit price and line total (price × quantity), and the cart total.
outcomes: every product in the cart is listed
each listed product shows its quantity
each listed product shows its unit price
each listed product shows its line total, equal to unit price × quantity
the cart total is shown

acs.text: DELETE /carts/{id}/product/{productId} removes the product (204); the cart no longer lists it.
outcomes: DELETE /carts/{id}/product/{productId} responds 204
the cart no longer lists the removed product

acs.text: Deleting a cart responds 204 and is idempotent: deleting a cart that was already deleted also responds 204.
outcomes: deleting a cart → 204
deleting the same cart again → 204

acs.text: Any request for a cart that does not exist responds 404 with the message "Cart not found".
outcomes: a request for a cart id that never existed responds 404 (read, add product, remove product, delete cart)
the response carries the message "Cart not found"

rules.text: The web shop keeps the cart across page views.
A quantity from 1 to 99 is accepted when adding a product; a quantity outside 1–99 is rejected and leaves the cart unchanged.
The cart is for guests (not signed in); carts are anonymous.

errorModel.case: adding a product with a quantity outside 1–99
errorModel.body: an error for the quantity field

errorModel.case: any request for a cart that does not exist, including deleting a cart id that never existed (see G7 for deleting an already-deleted cart)

oracleGaps.value: only for a cart that was already deleted: deleting it again responds 204 (AC-7, the more specific statement). Every other request for a cart that does not exist, including DELETE /carts/{id} on a cart id that never existed, responds 404 "Cart not found" (AC-8)
the cart icon shows the sum of the quantities of all products in the cart
the cart total equals the sum of the line totals
